If a change in these parameters is not stipulated for the manufacturing process, then to obtain the adjusted shape change it is necessary to change the mechanical characteristics of the metal workpiece, including the yield point and Young's modulus. It will require either completely substituting the workpiece material or providing it heat treatment. The plate width decisively influences the amount of bending, since its value being in the second degree is included into the formula. Thus, to improve the production of trays for electrical networks by bending sheet blanks, it is recommended to choose at the correct ratio between the width and length of the workpiece. Under other unchanged conditions as to the material and thickness of the original workpiece, the plate length and width varying results in a change of the deflection magnitude in the center of the finished product. Applying this method for manufacturing the curved plates as a structural element of electric trays, we can reduce their technological cost and electricity consumption with only using the lower power press equipment.

articleTitle: Features of Implementing The Competency-Based Approach to Teaching Engineering Students in The Context of Industry 4.0
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 4th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: Based on an analysis of economic development trends, the importance of the industrial sector of the economy has been identified. It has been argued that the further development of industries in the context of technological change in the formation of Industry 4.0 will have an impact on the labour market. The labour market, in turn, will impose updated requirements on engineering specialists in terms of a set of professional competences. Employers' requirements for the knowledge and skills of future employees are also changing. Therefore, the implementation of a competency-based approach in the training of engineering students is becoming more relevant in today's digitalised society. In this regard, the study proposes the use of distance education as a relevant tool for implementing the competency-based approach in Industry 4.0. The authors pointed out the features and advantages of distance education in gaining knowledge and developing professional competences for future engineers. In addition, the paper presents a list of key competences for engineering students in the context of shaping Industry 4.0.

articleTitle: Active Canceling of Magnetic Field with Circular Space-Time Characteristic based on Multi Criteria Game Solution
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 4th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: In this paper we present a method for determining the number, configuration, spatial arrangement and currents of canceling coils, parameters of the control system regulator as well as the resulting induction of the magnetic field value in the canceling space for magnetic field with circular spatio-temporal characteristic, generated by overhead power lines with delta arrangement of wires. The design of two degree of freedom robust system of active canceling based on multi-criteria stochastic game decision, which calculated by particles multiswarm stochastic multi-agent optimization algorithms from Pareto-optimal solutions. Multi-criteria game vector payoff calculated basis on the Maxwell equations quasi-stationary approximation solution. Computer modeling and field experimental research of synthesized system of active canceling carried out.

articleTitle: Expert Assessment of Information Protection in Complex Energy Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 4th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The paper considers the important problem of information protection in complex energy systems. The expert assessment of information protection in complex energy systems method has been developed. Based on the conducted research and data processing, a method of forming the analytical basis for decision-making aimed at ensuring the competitiveness of complex information protection systems has been developed.

articleTitle: The Effect Frequency Characteristics of the Series Active Filter with a Voltage-positive Transformer Power Circuit on Quality of Filtering
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 4th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The article is devoted to study the effect frequency characteristics of the series active filter with a voltage-positive transformer power circuit on quality of filtering. Therefore, the work's purpose is to study the frequency characteristics of the power circuit and the filter-compensating device. A study of its frequency characteristics was carried out according to the scheme power circuit of the network using the state space theory. When analyzing the obtained data, a decrease in the power circuit efficiency was noted when the frequency increased. Using the four-pole method, the power active filter frequency characteristics were investigated. The obtained results analysis showed that when increasing the frequency, to maintain the active filter input current at a given level, it is necessary to increase the filter input voltage. Also, the obtained data show that when increasing the frequency, in order to maintain the filter output current, which, taking into account the magnetizing current, is related to the current at the filter input, at a given level, measures must be taken to force the voltage at the compensator output.

articleTitle: Improving the Efficiency of a Multistage Evaporator Station for Sugar Production Using Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 4th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The paper shows the process of developing a model of multistage evaporator station of a sugar factory based on a neural network. The neural network predicts the main performance indicators of the multistage evaporator station, such as the concentration of syrup at the output of the evaporator and the amount of evaporated water at the station. Unlike existing solutions, forecasting is performed in real time based on a set of indicators of the automation system (temperatures, flow rates, levels, pressure, density in the apparatus) and industrial laboratory (concentration of solids at the inlet to the evaporation station). The proposed neural network model has an MLP structure with 27 inputs, 2 outputs and one hidden layer with 20 neurons and predicts these indicators with an error of less than 5%. This allows to increase the informative support of the operator-technologist on the quality indicators of the enterprise without additional load on the industrial laboratory and without additional cost automatic quality devices, as well as to perform timely adjustment of the technological mode of the department.

articleTitle: Sliding Mode Aperiodization with the N-i Switching Method by Modifying the Quasi-Optimal Motion Profile
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 4th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: Applying of discontinuous position control algorithms provides electric drives with high performance ratings in the parametric synthesis of controllers using the N-i switching method. A typical requirement for the formation of aperiodic transients is imposed on electromechanical position control systems. For its implementation, a purposeful improvement of the mathematical apparatus of this method is required, which is carried out in this work by correcting the shape of a dynamic trajectory that is quasi-optimal in terms of speed. The obtained solution of the problem is illustrated by numerical examples and simulation results. The improved synthesis procedure is presented in the form of a computational algorithm.

articleTitle: The Development of the Automatic Control System for the Production Process of the Heating the Bandages of Large Composite Rolling Rolls to be Dismantled
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 4th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: the aim of the work is to develop a dynamics control system for the production process of the heating the bandages of large composite rolling roll to be dismantled. One of the important areas that allow increasing the economic effect in resource-intensive technologies is the process of restoring large-sized compound rolls of rolling mills. The defining operation of this process is the separation of the mating bandage and the roll's axis by thermal action on the embracing part. The general principles and results of the development, research and creation of an improved technological process for heating the products under study in a high-speed heating furnace have been described the proposed the automatic control system consists of electric drive, controller, closed loop and state observer. Some signals are impractical to measure because the objects being measured may be inaccessible for such reasons as harsh environments. Therefore, it is suggested to use a state observer. This method can be used to improve the process of heating the bandages of large composite rolling rolls to be dismantled. The expediency of subsequent research and development of the control system for the optimal performing of the heating process of the roll has been established.

articleTitle: Starting System of Induction Motor with Dynamic Torque Control Powered by an Autonomous Sources of Energy Supply
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 4th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The paper considers the application of starting systems for induction motors powered by autonomous sources of limited power. The conditions for the formation of the starting torque of an induction motor with the formation of the required transient characteristics and the control of electromagnetic transient moments under conditions of power supply from a stationary network and an autonomous sources of energy supply of limited power are analyzed. Studies have been carried out on the implementation of the “favorable” switching on mode of a three-phase induction motor powered by an autonomous generator according to the principle of creating non-zero initial conditions. An implementation algorithm has been developed and a technical solution has been proposed for the implementation of a starting device with the implementation of a “quasi-favorable” method for switching on an induction motor under conditions of power supply from autonomous sources of energy supply.

articleTitle: Information Technologies Implementation to Ensure the Project-Based Distance Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 4th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The article considers the peculiarities of Information Technologies implementation in the distance learning process on the project-based approach. Studies have confirmed that, in addition to technical and information issues, distance education is complicated by the level of training of specialists, which affects the level of the necessary knowledge required for effective realisation of educational projects. Insufficient level of mastery of project-based methodological tools for distance learning, lack of willingness to implement IT innovations for educational content systematisation, and the educational space organisation are often the reasons that don't let Higher Education Institutions (HEI) expand e-learning profitability. In order to increase the level of compliance of the educational process with the needs of students and the educational services market, it is necessary to constantly modernize the learning process. For this, it is necessary to constantly test new educational formats, gamify the educational process, in particular, implement project-based distance learning by implementing modern information technologies.

articleTitle: Principles of Development of Effective Control Algorithms for Heating Systems of Communal and Residential Buildings
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 4th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: Peculiarities of centralized heating control of communal and residential buildings in the conditions of sharp change of parameters of external environment are considered. The humidity and temperature influence on the condition of enclosing structures and the microclimate of indoor premises caused by it are studied. The principles of construction of the control algorithms for the achievement of optimum expenses of the heat carrier at preservation of the necessary level of comfort for people and storage or proper functioning of the equipment are determined. The efficiency of the developed approaches on the basis of automatic weather control systems is investigated.

articleTitle: Method for Evaluating the Stability of Arc Burning of Electrodes with Rutile-Cellulosic Covering
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 4th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The article presents a method for evaluating the stability of arc burning of covered electrodes with predominant globular and spray transfer of the electrode metal that allows with high reliability to quantitatively evaluate the process parameters considering the local effect of short- circuits. The evaluation methodology is adapted to the capabilities of the UPE-500 laboratory complex, which provides for automatic fixation, processing and recording of the received data with simultaneous stabilization of welding modes that is also performed in automatic mode. Bibliogr. 10, tab. 1, fig. 2.

articleTitle: Designing the Cybernetic Model of Ore Grinding Technological Operation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 4th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The aim of the work is increasing of industrial complexes operation profitability for ore's grinding and classification at mining and beneficiation factories by introducing complex performance factors into the technological regimes process forming. To solve the given problem, the provisions of the efficiency theory, methods of building extreme control systems are used. The model for determining the overall efficiency of technological complex production activity has been created. This model performs calculations based on available technological signals and allows determining the task effects of technological regulators based on profitability requirements. The paper proposes an approach to replacing the quality criterion with an analytically determined global optimum criterion for improving the profitability of the iron ore's grinding and classifying technological process, based on the provisions of the efficiency theory. Synthesized structural diagram of the system for determining the components of the optimality criterion considers all significant parameters of raw materials, energy, resource of equipment and finished product. On the basis of the conducted research, it becomes possible to determine the structure and composition of the hardware and software of the optimal control system for wet grinding area and ensure the maximum possible profitability of the technological complex.

articleTitle: Enhancement of the effectiveness of wind turbines with aerodynamic multiplication
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 4th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: In this paper, we presented analysis of wind turbines with aerodynamic multiplication and shown possibilities to increase their efficiency, reduce weight and cost of electrical equipment in comparison with the classical schemes of horizontal axis wind turbines. This is reached due to the specific properties of energy conversion in wind turbines with aerodynamic multiplication, namely, the generator speed is constant at variable speed of wind machine; the multiplier is absent; higher dynamic stability under wind gusts. We have shown the possibility to realize universal technical solutions, regardless of the state of weather conditions and changes in the parameters of the power transmission system. We have presented the most real variants to realize high-power energy conversion schemes, which enable us to increase the effectiveness of wind turbines with aerodynamic multiplication, depending on their capacity. A number of technical solutions have been confirmed experimentally and on simulation models.

articleTitle: Comparison of Energy-Power Parameters and Electrical Energy Consumption During Cold Rolling with Emulsions at Continuous 4-Stand Mill 1680
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 4th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The work compares the energy consumption during cold rolling on a four-stand mill 1680 of carbon steel with the use of lubricating-cooling emulsions “Quakerol ZAP 4.0” and “Universal-1TS”. It was revealed that the average total load on the stand motors and coiler when using “Quakerol ZAP 4.0” emulsion is 4.19% higher than when rolling the same product range, rolled on “Universal-1TC” emulsion. It was shown that the total specific power consumption when rolling on emulsion prepared from “Quakerol ZAP 4.0” emulsion is higher by 2.7% than when rolling on emulsion prepared from standard “Universal-1TC” emulsion. The need for further research with the selection of the optimal emulsion concentration from “Quakerol ZAP 4.0”, to achieve a reduction in energy consumption for rolling is shown.

articleTitle: End Winding Inductance Analysis of the Three-Phase Induction Motor
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 4th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: In this paper, the influence of the end winding leakage inductance on the three-phase induction motor characteristics has been investigated. The most common analytical equations used for the end winding leakage inductance calculations are analyzed, compared and implemented into the finite element method based models of the induction machine. The main differences between the end winding leakage inductance calculation approaches have been identified via comparison of the output motor characteristics obtained from the 2D numerical models. Based on the 2D numerical simulations the prototype was produced. The experimental measurements were performed to determine the most appropriate analytical equations for the end winding calculation.

articleTitle: Possibility of Using Technologies of Augmented and Virtual Reality for Acquisition Hard and Soft Skills of Electrical Engineering Specialists
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 4th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The paper explores the possibilities of using augmented and virtual reality technologies to create distance online courses in order to ensure the acquisition of hard and soft skills of electrical engineering specialists. The use of 3D visualization, animation, sound accompaniment, subtitling in the development and formation of training courses of educational components allows you to fill it with the necessary informational content, immersing the student in a real production environment. The use of augmented reality allows you to adapt the educational process and provide the necessary competencies for the real technological process and equipment.

articleTitle: Improvement of the Simulation Model of a Solar Power Plant, Modernization of the Block for Accounting for the Effect of Cooling Panels by Wind Currents
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 4th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: This research article is dedicated to improving the existing simulation model of a solar power plant, serving as a potential tool for prediction in the field. The improvement is achieved by updating the block model of the effect of heating the surface of the photovoltaic converter by introducing a new mathematical model that more accurately describes the cooling of the surface of solar panels by wind currents.

articleTitle: Improving the Energy Parameters of Medium Power Induction Electric Motors by Changing the Shape of the Rod along the Length of the Squirrel Cage Rotor
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 4th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The paper describes a number of modifications of induction motors, in which the improvement of energy parameters is achieved by changing the shape of the rod along the length of the rotor. This enhances the effect of current displacement during starting in comparison with conventional motors, increases the starting torque and reduces the starting current.

articleTitle: Characterization of 3D Printing Filament Diameter with Diffraction Method in Teraherz Domain
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 4th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: This work is devoted to characterization of 3D printing filament diameter by diffraction method in teraherz frequency domain. The subject of research in this work is the process of interaction of radiation with a filament, diffraction of the plane wave on the filament and diffraction pattern, the determination of the geometric dimensions of the filament and its defects on the basis of diffraction patterns. The wave equation with boundary conditions is used as a mathematical description. The solution of the wave equation makes it possible to find the field strengths, and through the field strengths to find the scattering indicatrix. The scattering indicatrix shows how the intensity of the scattered wave is distributed in space around the irradiated filament cylinder. The distance between two minimum on the indicatrix allows to find the diameter of the filament. If the filament is irradiated from two sources, it is possible to define the shape of the filament, that is, external defects. If a two-layer filament was analyzed than by the asymmetry of its indicatrix, it is possible to judge whether the two layers of the filament are coaxial or not. This is useful in the future for identification of internal defects of filament.

articleTitle: Modeling and Experimental Evaluation of Lithium Iron Phosphate Battery
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 4th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The main objective of this paper is to present lithium iron phosphate battery modeling and experimental evaluation. The modeling of the battery was performed using the Thevenin equivalent circuit model with two RC branches and the nonlinear least squares method with the Levenberg-Marquardt optimization algorithm for parameter estimation. The modeling technique presents the most applicable and trivial solution to study and describe the behavior and performance of the battery. The experimental evaluation was performed on a 7,7 kWh battery pack installed at the Institute of Energy Technology, Faculty of Energy Technology, University of Maribor. Based on the estimated parameters of the Thevenin equivalent circuit, the model results show good agreement with measurements. The average mean absolute error method was used for determining the accuracy of the estimated parameters, with the state of charge and voltage being 8,38 % and 0,34 %, respectively.

articleTitle: The Feed Water Level Improved Automated Control for Steam Generators of Nuclear Power Plants
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 4th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: This research deals with developing the approach to design the improved automated control systems for the feed water level in steam generators of nuclear power plants. It is developed the general theory required to build the mathematical models of nuclear power plants steam generators to have the suitable mathematical models to design the improved automated control systems for the feed water level. It is proposed the generalized approach for defining the parameters of improved automated controllers for the feed water level on the basis of the developed general theory of mathematical models of the steam generators. The relationships between the proposed and classical approaches to design the automated systems for the feed water level in steam generators of nuclear power plants are theoretically researched, and the influence of evaporation mirror area on the parameters of the feed water level linear controllers is shown. The results of computer simulations of the feed water level in the steam generators to show some opportunities of the proposed approach are presented.

articleTitle: Magnetic Field Active Canceling Single-Circuit System for Old Residential One-Story Buildings Closed to Double-Circuit Overhead Power Lines
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 4th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: First design and study effectiveness reducing magnetic field level double-circuit power lines in residential old one-story buildings using a single-circuit active canceling system with one compensation winding is conducted. During the design of an active shielding system, the geometric dimensions and spatial arrangement of the compensation winding are determined, as well as the phase shift and the magnitude of the current in the compensation winding. The design reduced to computing vector game solution, in which the game payoff vector calculated based on the Biot-Savart law. The game solution calculated based on multi-swarm stochastic multi-agent optimization algorithms. The results of modeling and experimental study of magnetic field level reducing effectiveness generated by double-circuit power lines in residential old one-story buildings, using a single-circuit active canceling system with one compensation winding are considered.

articleTitle: Developing Electrical Engineering Specialties Teachers' Professional Competence in the Conditions of Martial Law
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 4th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: Developing electrical engineering specialties teachers' professional competence in the conditions of martial law is researched. Developing high school teachers' professional competence is especially relevant, because the success of educational activity depends on flexibility and critical thinking, pedagogical skills, and the ability to adequately respond to challenges. The novelty of the research lies in the characterization of the modification of developing electrical engineering specialties teachers' professional competence and its monitoring in the conditions of martial law. In the conditions of the introduction of martial law in order to develop the pedagogical competence of electrical engineering specialties teachers, its monitoring and evaluation, effective means are the creation and presentation of the teacher's electronic portfolio, observation of the lesson with further discussion, as well as pedagogical reflection.

Author Keywords: monitoring and evaluation of the professional competence development

articleTitle: The Energy Method for the Diagnosis of the Emergency Modes of Electrohydraulic Complex Electromechanical Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 4th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: A method for diagnosing unsteady modes of electrohydraulic complex electromechanical systems based on monitoring of energy processes as part of the variable-frequency electric drive of the pump has been developed. It is based on the analysis of instantaneous power derivatives and its amplitude-frequency characteristics at all elements of the energy channel. Diagnostic signs of the identification of emergency modes have been determined and a set of organizational and technical measures has been formulated to prevent the development of an unsteady mode by using hydrodynamic and cavitation protection devices, active energy absorbers and devices for reducing dynamic loads in pipeline networks.

articleTitle: Asynchronous Motor with Ferromagnetic Sections of Squirrel-Cage Winding
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 4th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: One of the ways of energy and resource savingis is to reduce the voltage of a squirrel-cage motor when the asynchronous electric drive underloaded. The requirements for an asynchronous motor operating in conjunction with a semiconductor voltage regulator are proposed. It is necessary to maintain an approximate constancy of the ratio of idle and load losses during regulation and to achieve small nonlinear distortions and slip changes in the working areas of the adjusting mechanical characteristics. Small starting current multiplications and increased starting torques are also required. The fulfillment of such requirements is achieved by the formation of an “excavator” mechanical characteristic of the motor using the effect of current displacement in shielded or ferromagnetic sections of the short-circuited winding. The fulfillment of these requirements increases the technical and economic performance and competitiveness of the named electric drive. The efficiency of the installation of ferromagnetic elements in the short-circuiting frontal sections of the rotor winding has been confirmed experimentally. Technological technical solutions of rotor options with frontal ferromagnetic elements consist in the installation of tubular steel shanks with protrusions of connection with the winding elements on the shaft.

articleTitle: Investigation of the Voltage Distortion Effect by External Consumers on the Power Consumption Mode of a Controlled Three-phase Rectifier
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 4th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The electrical energy consumers, as a rule, are responsible for the violation of its quality. Part of this violation depends on the characteristics of the source and the power supply network. In rare cases, violations of the quality of electrical energy depend on generating installations. The paper analyzes the equivalent circuits of power lines. For a CL that provides power to a three-phase rectifier, the change in active resistance in the presence of current higher harmonics is taken into account. A model has been developed for the network-CL-transformer-rectifier-load structure. A subsystem has been synthesized that implements a change in the line active resistance in the presence of current harmonics. A number of experiments were implemented during which the difference in power losses from higher harmonics was investigated. It has been established that in the voltage harmonics presence caused by third-party consumers, the level of power losses in the line from higher harmonics decreases.

articleTitle: Improving the Accuracy of Measuring the Mechanical Characteristics of Materials for UAV Elements Using Programmable Testing Machines
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 4th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: In recent years, global aircraft manufacturers have seen significant progress towards the use of 3D printing. They note the high efficiency of these technologies in terms of economic and temporal parameters. At the same time, there is an obvious need for a large amount of experimental research of equipment, materials used, as well as the development of manufacturing technology for a particular part, followed by certification for aviation purposes. The possibility of using the Nylon 12CF material for UAV repair is considered; for this purpose, its mechanical properties are determined.

articleTitle: Determination of the Permissible Range of Turbogenerators Non-Nominal Operating Modes at Thermal Power Plants
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 4th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: Turbogenerators of Ukraine thermal power plants have practically exhausted their service life, but their complete replacement is impossible in the coming years. The problem is aggravated by the fact that currently these turbogenerators not only produce electricity, but also solve the task of maintaining the nominal parameters of electrical networks during periods of peaks and dips in energy consumption. Such regimes cause their accelerated wear. In order to ensure the reliability of turbogenerators, it is necessary to understand in which non-nominal modes they can work under the condition of minimal additional load on the stator core fastening mechanical elements, in which the most defects were found during operation and repairs. Such studies were carried out for the tightening prisms of the stator core. The influence of the mode change was analyzed by the change in vibration on the body and on the bearing supports of the turbogenerator when its active power was reduced to 70%, 50% and 30% of the nominal one. Using the Solid-Works software complex, the distribution of mechanical stresses in rigid tightening prisms was determined. On the basis of these data, for the modes of reducing the turbogenerators load with a capacity of 200–300 MW, the intervals of permissible unloading are recommended under the condition of minimum mechanical stresses in the stator fastening elements.

articleTitle: Development of a Method of Increasing the Sensitivity of Gas Sensors
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 4th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: In this paper, the frequency dependences of the capacitance of the multilayer structure of matrix sensors with thick layers of porous semiconductor in vacuum and gas medium (hydrogen, carbon dioxide) are studied, it is determined that in vacuum the capacitance changes little with frequency variation. When the sensor is moved to the environment of H2 or CO2 with a concentration of 100 to 10000ppm C(f), the characteristics of the matrix sensor shift towards high capacitance values, and with increasing concentration, the capacitance is weakly dependent on frequency in the low frequency region and changes significantly at 103 Hz. The higher the concentration, the more high-frequency region shifts the area of sharp increase in capacitance. A method of processing signals from porous matrix sensors is also proposed, which is characterized by the use of polyharmonic power supply with a tuned set of frequencies, which allows to reduce the capacitance of the measured structure to the capacitance of the porous semiconductor layer and directly measure the dielectric constant of the porous layer. An important feature of the method is the use of a wide range of frequencies (102–106 Hz), at which the change in C(w), due to adsorption of gases, and takes into account only slow processes of current transfer in the gas-sensitive semiconductor material, which determines the corresponding change in the elements of the equivalent electrical circuit, including CPE.

articleTitle: Study Of The Dynamics Of Solidification Of A Continuously Cast Ingot On The Improved Mathematical Model Of The Process Of Soft Compression
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 4th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: the aim of the work is to develop and study a mathematical model of ingot solidification to determine the exact parameters of soft reduction. To solve this problem, the appropriate method is the finite difference method (grid method). An explicit difference scheme was used to solve the considered differential equation. A refined mathematical model of ingot solidification has been developed, the numerical solution of which will make it possible to obtain the temperature field in the ingot cross section, and, therefore, will make it possible to more accurately obtain the parameters of soft reduction. A computer program has been developed that calculates the temperature field of a continuously cast ingot along its entire length. Using this program, you can calculate the technological parameters of soft reduction. The modeling of the crystallization process has been carried out. The data obtained were evaluated for adequacy and used in the development of practical recommendations and adjustment of the operating modes of the soft reduction roller section on a vertical slab continuous casting machine (SCCM). This method of mathematical modeling can be used for the calculation and theoretical analysis of the thermal regimes of the CCM at a variable speed of pulling the ingot.

articleTitle: An Analysis of Field Weakening Mode in DTC Based Induction Drive for Control Influences Forming
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 4th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The article deals with DTC-based induction drives. DTC systems provide the same regulated properties as AC electric drives like DC electric drives. To expand the speed-range ratio in a DTC-based induction motor and provide a motor work with speed above its synchronous speed, it is necessary to weaken the induction-motor field. At the same time, DTC-based induction-motor work in the field weakening zone requires improvement. Therefore, the task of control-strategy synthesis in the field weakening zone of the DTC-based induction motor is very important. To ensure satisfactory dynamic and static characteristics of DTC-based induction drive in the zone of flux weakening, it is advisable to change the flux linkage in inverse proportion to the change in speed. The field-weakening mode in DTC-based induction motor in order to determine a control influence in case of two-zone speed regulation is analyzed.

articleTitle: Teaching Electrical Engineering Students the Skill of Academic Reading
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 4th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The article analyses the academic reading skills as the essential pillar in teaching students of electrical engineering specialties academic activities. The importance of such academic reading skills during student's education period concerning international requirements and standards is featured. The importance of academic reading in scientific research is determined. A quantitative study was conducted among students of electrical engineering specialties. The most common mistakes in academic reading are analyzed. Detailed attention is paid to the features of scientific literature studying.

articleTitle: A National Component in Shaping the Worldview of Electrical Engineering Students
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 4th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The article is devoted to the analysis of practical application of the theoretical knowledge gained by electrical students in the process of studying social disciplines. A significant influence on the formation of the national component of the worldview of electrical engineering students who study social disciplines and educational activities, the content of which is related to the history of the Ukrainian statehood formation and development, has been proven. Knowledge and determination of research results are implemented with the help of the following research methods: constructive analysis, synthesis, induction and deduction, visualization, analogy method, as well as the use of specific historical methods such as historical-genetic, historical-comparative. Person-oriented learning, as well as the importance of applying in practical visualization the theoretical knowledge obtained in university classrooms, is proven. This article has shown the influence of historical knowledge on the student's formation of civic attitudes. The ability to analyze and comprehend historical processes as well as to distinguish between objective and fake information has also been presented. This article has proved the importance of the investment of acquired knowledge in sustainable innovative scientific and technical development of society and the protection of Ukrainian statehood.

articleTitle: Assessment of Learning Outcomes in Distance Learning Using the Moodle Platform
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 4th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The testing on the Moodle platform as a means of assessing the achievement of program learning outcomes in distance is researched on the example of mathematical disciplines at the Kremenchuk Mykhailo Ostrohradskyi National University. In the context of a pandemic, there is an intensification of distance learning. In connection with this, various platforms are being created for organizing online training. The krnu.org system on the Moodle platform is a modern distance education service that allows, first of all, to organize effective control of knowledge using a wide range of different tasks. The assessment criteria are clear and understandable for students. Testing makes it possible to check the programmatic learning outcomes, which is shown by the example of the study of mathematics by students of engineering specialties. The types and functions of testing in engineer's mathematical training in distance learning on the Moodle platform are investigated. A diagram of testing in mathematics for students of engineering specialties has been built.

articleTitle: Influence of Winding Dimensions on Electrical Parameters of the Induction System with a Magnetic Core for Magneto-Impulse Processing of Thin Non-Magnetic Metal Sheets
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 4th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: Plasticity of electrically conductive materials changes by flowing high-density currents through them. This electroplastic effect can be used to remove residual stresses of welds. In this article the induction system for decreasing residual stresses in welds of thin non-magnetic metal sheets of aluminum alloys 5056, 5083 and similar is investigated. The magneto-impulse method is used, which is based on inducing a pulsed eddy current in the weld. The aim of this work is to establish the dependence of electrical parameters (resistance, inductance) and current density in welds on the winding sizes in order to obtain the maximum current density in welds or reduce the requirements for a power source, taking into account skin and proximity effects of conductors in winding. The numerical calculation of the electromagnetic field by the finite element method in the mode of harmonic currents and in the mode of transient processes is used. The influence of winding sizes is established on resistance, inductance, current density of weld surface, AC/DC resistance ratio coefficient in winding in the calculation mode of harmonic currents. It also establishes the dependence of transient processes of pulsed current in winding, current density in weld of the induction system on cross-sectional dimensions of a coil and its wires.

articleTitle: Connecting Elements for Electric Cables with a Hollow Section
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 4th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: It is shown that the electricity transmission over long distances is accompanied by electrical losses. These energy losses depend on the line layout, the wires material and their quality, cable fittings and the service life of the system as a whole. The desire to save expensive non-ferrous metals and increasing loads on power lines led designers to the idea of creating hollow wires. The construction length of hollow cables is limited, therefore, cable sleeves are used to connect them. The coupling zone is subject to electrochemical corrosion, thermal and mechanical stresses, and the service life, like the cable, must be at least 30 years. Therefore, high demands are placed on the manufacture of couplings in terms of wall thickness and geometric dimensions accuracy. It is shown that it is more economical to manufacture these connecting elements using a hood. At the same time, experimentally verified recommendations are given regarding the drawing method and the choice of tool design parameters.

articleTitle: Multithreaded Software Control of Industrial Manipulator Movement
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 4th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: Modern production requires the use of automation tools in the manufacturing process. One of the most commonly used technical means is an industrial manipulator. The concept of Industry 4.0 involves the use of special software tools that allow you to conveniently and visually debug control programs using the visualization of the process of simulating the movement of its mechanical parts in real time. This paper describes the technique of multithreaded software control of the movement of a two-link manipulator with three degrees of freedom. The proposed technique uses a set of independent timers, which allow to implement independent flows of controlling the progress of program execution. The process of distributing tasks between threads and the synchronization algorithm are described. The proposed technique can be used both for simulating the manipulator motion control process and for direct motion control using a serial data transfer interface and commands in G-Code format.

articleTitle: Comparison of Thermal Loads a Single-Phase Transformer With a Laminated Magnetic Core
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 4th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: A promising direction for improving transformers is to transform structures and design of the electromagnetic systems. Rod and armored laminated magnetic cores of single-phase transformers are made of anisotropic electrical steel. Such magnetic circuits contain, respectively, four and six angular zones of magnetic flux direction change relative to the texture of steel with laminated joints, which causes significant additional losses. Improvement of single-phase transformers is possible by replacing named planar systems with a symmetrical radial electromagnetic system with three angular zones of three-rod magnetic circuit. Based on the method of invariant objective functions with dimensionless optimization components and universal relative controlled variables, mathematical models for determining the average thermal loads of the windings of the named variants of oil single-phase transformers with voltage up to 1000 V have been developed. The possibility of checking and comparing the thermal design constraint during the optimization of transformer is provided. The advantages of the radial electromagnetic system of a single-phase transformer with a three-rod magnetic circuit are shown.

articleTitle: Forecasting of SPP Generation at Different Stages of its Existence Using the Example of the 2.3 MW Plant in the Kharkiv Region of Ukraine
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 4th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The results of studies of the generation of a solar power plant (SPP) with a capacity of 2.336 MW, which is located in the Kharkiv region of Ukraine, are presented. The results of the forecast generation, which were determined using the PHOTOVOLTAIC GEOGRAPHICAL INFORMATION SYSTEM (PV-GIS) program. Analysis of the forecast and actual generation data showed that the actual annual deviation from the forecast ranged from +5.47% to −5.24%, which is slightly higher than the annual generation variability of 4.87% determined by PV-GIS. The economic performance of a solar power plant is affected by the accuracy of forecasting hourly generation a day in advance. In order to improve the accuracy of forecasting the hourly generation of the SPP, an analysis of data from the guaranteed buyer, who buys all the generated electricity, and the plant's SmartLogger1000 monitoring system was performed. According to the results of the analysis, it was found that there is a difference in the data of the guaranteed buyer and the monitoring system, which arose as a result of the non-synchronization of the SmartLogger1000 monitoring system with the guaranteed buyer. The analysis of the hourly forecasts of the guaranteed buyer and the forecasting service showed that the sum of the hourly deviations of the forecast of the SPP service from the actual generation for December 2022 was 71.4%, and the sum of the hourly deviations of the forecast of the guaranteed buyer was 117.9%. An increase in the accuracy of forecasting was achieved due to the accumulation of statistical data and the study of factors influencing the generation of SPP.

articleTitle: Effect of Anthropogenic Relief on the Efficiency of Hydrothermal Circulation Heat Pump System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 4th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: This paper describes the results of analytical and experimental studies performed at the geothermal test site of the Research Center of the Institute of Renewable Energy of the National Academy of Sciences of Ukraine. On the basis of experimental data, the necessity of a preliminary analysis of the existing anthropogenic impact on the underground aquifer when choosing the location of the hydrothermal heat pump system is substantiated. Parameters have been determined that show the presence of a technogenic impact on the hydrosphere in the area where the wells are located, which open the aquifer. The paper describes a hydrothermal heat pump installation. The characteristics of the measuring equipment are described. The results of experimental studies and analytical calculations are presented. The results of experimental studies of annual, seasonal and daily changes in water temperature in the aquifer and air temperature in the tubular annulus are presented. Changes in the hydrological parameters of a well that opened an aquifer under the influence of natural and urban processes were determined. A set of measures to reduce negative impact of the HydroPS system on water condition in the open aquifer has been defined. The heat pump system transformation coefficient has been calculated. Optimal designs of low-grade water energy extraction systems for the anthropogenically loaded conditions have been suggested. The data obtained during the study have important scientific and applied significance when designing hydrothermal heat pump systems.

articleTitle: Monitoring of Energy Processes in the Electrohydraulic Complex with a Variable-Frequency Electric Drive in Unsteady Operation Modes
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 4th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: An energy model of an electrohydraulic complex has been developed. It allows analyzing the energy processes in the power channel in dynamic modes during the development of cavitation and turbulent oscillations in the pipeline network. It has been shown that the nature of energy processes in the considered cases is periodic constant power fluctuations in the analyzed time interval. The variable component in technological and energy signals of the electrohydraulic complex has been assessed. Their frequency analysis has been performed. The coefficient of power controllability of the electrohydraulic complex and its critical values, whereat the development of emergency modes is possible, have been determined.

articleTitle: Calculation of Effective Magnetic Properties Rod Matrices of High-Gradient Magnetic Separators
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 4th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: It is shown that generalization of the universal equation of magnetostatics concerning the magnetization vector of the medium as applied to double-periodic heterogeneous media allows obtaining a universal mathematical model to study rod matrices of high-gradient magnetic separators. The results of numerical modelling of the homogenization problem for matrices of arbitrary geometry and concentration of elements forming the inhomogeneous field both in linear and nonlinear formulations are presented. Particular attention is paid to the need of determining effective matrix parameters both when designing a separator and optimizing geometric parameters of its matrix.

articleTitle: On the Issue of Assessing the Thermal Stability of the Electric Machine Rotor Based on Experimental Research of Its Heating
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 4th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The results of the research of the thermal state of the active zone of the smooth rotor of a powerful full-scale electric machine in asynchronous modes are given. A comparison with the results of experimental research of temperatures is made based on the developed complex methodological and software support for numerical mathematical modeling and calculation of physical fields by the finite element method and data from full-scale tests of the machine. The discrepancies between the obtained theoretical values of heating on the surface are analyzed in comparison with the experimental values for the depth of the rotor array. Differences in the maximum calculated and actually measured temperatures are established. Their values may exceed 50°/0, and in the initial sections of the short-term process - more than 100%, which thus negatively affects the assessment of the “true” thermal stability of the structure only on the basis of experimental data. It is shown that thermal processes in the rotor are also a factor limiting the load of the electric machine when operating in long-term slip modes.

articleTitle: Development of a Synchronous Motor with Frequency Control System for Light Industry Equipment
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 4th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: This article is devoted to the development of a synchronous motor using the finite element method to determine the main mechanical characteristics. The obtained dependences of the moment on the speed of the rotor. The engine is controlled by a frequency system that was developed. Obtained experimental data of the developed electric drive. This drive is intended for ejection in light industry equipment, such as: shredders, elevators, conveyors, etc.

articleTitle: Comparison of Active Power Losses of Single-Phase Electromagnetic Static Devices by Radial Electromagnetic System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 4th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: A numerical calculation and comparative analysis of the single-phase transformers active power losses were carried out. The electromagnetic static devices compared have a radial structure of an electromagnetic system with a hexagonal and a tetrahedral rod cross-section. The features of the calculation of active power losses of transformers and reactors according to the optimization criterion of the minimum number of losses based on the objective function method with technical level indicators that include relative variables are shown. The influence of replacing rectangular shaping contours of rods and winding turns with hexagonal ones in variants of spatial radial twisted magnetic cores with a frequency of 400 Hz on active power losses is determined. An optimization comparison of the variants showed that the active power loss rate improves when the cross-section of the rods changes from rectangular to hexagonal at a frequency of 400 Hz.

articleTitle: Determination of Losses in Steel of an Induction Motor at Its Deep Saturation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 4th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The paper shows that the existing methods for determining steel losses of an induction machine are suitable only for the initial rectilinear (unsaturated) section of the magnetization curve, which gives a significant error in the saturation mode, or contain a large number of unknown elements, which makes it cumbersome and difficult to use the results in practical purposes. The proposed method is a further development of the well-known approach to determining steel losses. This takes into account the change in the magnetization inductance. This allows it to be used in high saturation mode. The expressions for determining steel losses are presented as a function of magnetic flux, EMF and current, which makes them suitable for practical use.

articleTitle: Driving the PWM-Controlled System to Monostable Behavior by Periodic Modulation of a Carrier Signal
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 4th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The normal (“nominal)” mode of operation of a PWM -driven power stage under several circumstances can be only one of multiple coexisting stable modes for the same set of parameters; that phenomenon is referred to as multistability. The “non-nominal” modes are most often characterized by lower efficiency and higher ripples and are undesired. That leads us to the search of the strategies to control those nonlinear phenomena. Our proposal is based on transferring the system to a monostable behavior utilizing a periodic modulation of a carrier signal. The applicability of the proposed control and the suitable ranges of the modulation strength are studied using the bifurcation diagram. In addition, if the control should provide a return to an uncontrolled state after the control goal is achieved, we demonstrate that an implementation should include smooth attenuation of the modulation strength to ensure the “nominal” operation after the control is disabled.

articleTitle: Increase Quality of Gaas Monocrystals for Solar Energy Devices Due to Control of Dislocations Using Alhorithm of Detection of Contour Lines of Etching Pits on Surface Waffer Semiconductor
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 4th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The quality and efficiency of solar energy devices depend on the quality of semiconductor single crystals, the structural perfection of which is determined by the number of dislocation pits, characterized by the density on the surface of the GaAs wafer after selective etching. The processing of digital images of the wafer surface makes it possible to automate the control of the production of semiconductor monocrystals GaAs. The purpose of the article is to develop for the first time an algorithm for detecting etching pit contour line on the image surface of a semiconductor wafer with minimal computational resources.

articleTitle: Effective Regional Clusters of Higher Education Institution and Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 4th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The paper presents the practice of the regional educational cluster, the center of which is the classical university - Kremenchuk Mykhailo Ostrohradskyi National University considers the prerequisites for its creation in the aspects of the current world trends and public policy in education. The authors clarify the prerequisites for its creation, stages of formation and principles; represented the benefits of participation in the educational cluster for educational institutions providing vocational training, different levels of education; outlined the main problems of clustering the educational system of the region.

Author Keywords: principles and advantages of the educational cluster

articleTitle: Mathematical Model of a Three-Phase Induction Motor with Asymmetrical Twelve-Zone Stator Windings
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 4th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The paper proposes a mathematical model of a three-phase induction motor with an asymmetrical twelve-zone winding of stator with parallel connection of subwindings. The mathematical model was developed using the theory of generalized electromechanical converter and contains equations of electrical equilibrium of six stator windings and three rotor windings. The equations for calculating the electromagnetic moment and the equations of motion of the induction motor with an asymmetrical twelve-zone stator winding rotor were obtained. The developed mathematical model in the form of cell-matrix equations has been implemented in MATLAB/Simulink.

articleTitle: Stabilization of Induction Motor with Fuzzy Controlled Floating DC Link Converter During Grid Voltage Disturbances
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 4th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: This paper introduces a floating DC link converter stabilizing a 3-ph induction motor during grid voltage imbalances created due to faults. The stator terminals of the machine are connected to grid and the rotor terminals are connected to VSI. The DC link side of the VSI is connected to a high value capacitor for voltage stabilization. This method of stabilization is only applicable for conditions of constant frequency operation which are generally fans or machines used for pumping. The purpose of this system is stabilization of induction motor during voltage disturbances without impact on load. For our consideration the 3-ph induction motor is induced with single line voltage sag and the stabilization is achieved using different controller schemes. The VSI is controlled with PI and FIS controllers determining the best controller doing a comparative analysis. The modelling of the test module with grid connected 3-ph induction motor and floating DC link stabilizing converter is done in MATLAB Simulink software.

articleTitle: Increasing the Energy Efficiency of Sheet Bending Equipment
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 4th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: It is shown that energy saving and energy efficiency increase should be considered as one of the main sources of future economic growth. The equipment that is used for the manufacture of products in the press shops has powerful electric motors. They are the main consumers of electrical energy. Replacing powerful electric motors with low-power ones will lead to energy savings. Crank bending machines are mainly used in mass production press shops. This calculation method makes it possible to control the deformation force and decrease it to reduce the overall operation of the press and its energy consumption. This will allow the use of less powerful presses for bending. It is shown that deformation occurs in two stages of sequential loading of the workpiece, which leads to splitting up the deformation process and, thereby, to decreasing the required force compared to the initial one. Using these analytical dependences for calculating the geometric dimensions of the resulting rift, it is possible to simplify the structure and design of the deforming tool, create a method for calculating technological and design parameters. The minimum force of the buffer, which must be used in the first operation, can be calculated based on the condition of maintaining the straightness of the workpiece and overcoming the resistance forces.

articleTitle: The Transformative Impact of the Development of Artificial Intelligence on Employment and Work Motivation in Business in the Conditions of the Information Economy
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 4th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The paper examines how the development of digital technologies, in particular artificial intelligence (AI), affects the labor market and changes the work process. It is argued that the main goal of enterprise management in the conditions of digital transformations is the formation of internal motivation among employees. As a result of this, the employee's dependence on positive and negative reinforcements from management decreases and self-motivation increases. The internal and external factors that contribute to the increase or decrease of the salary are determined. The role of the obtained results in further practical implementation is to make clear how AI algorithms help employees reach goals more efficiently - based on the study of cases of digitalization achievements in the field of motivation on the example of Ukrainian innovative companies the construction of the “needs - interests - incentives (motives) - result” scheme was proposed. Direct economic, indirect economic and non-monetary methods of motivation are considered and the main principles of the development of the motivation system are highlighted. It is emphasized that due to the training and retraining of personnel in such a way that the growth of their wages does not lag behind their productivity, and they receive wider opportunities for career growth, it is possible to ensure the sustainability of personnel policy in the conditions of the transformational impact of digitalization and AI.

articleTitle: Control Systems for the Temperature Field During Drawing, Taking into Account the Dynamic Modes of the Technological Installation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 4th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: Taking into account the modern realities of industrial production, today the task of improving the quality of welding wire in the drawing process using the electroplastic effect is relevant. The advantage of direct electric contact heating is substantiated by the possibility of obtaining the implementation and construction of a controlled process for the formation of the heating temperature during drawing. The control system is based on a proportional-integral-differential controller (PID controller), a power controller, a current source and an Apir-S measuring pyrometric complex, consisting of a primary pyrometric and secondary converter. By setting the appropriate coefficients of the PID controller, it is possible to form a stable operation mode with the formation of a controlled temperature regime during electric contact heating of the wire. It was experimentally established that, using the formation of a controlled temperature regime of annealing, due to the control of the heating temperature by a pyrometer, the control error did not exceed 1.3%. Compliance with the temperature of the annealing mode in the specified range provides the mechanical parameters of the products, namely wire, specified by the technological process. The methods adopted by the formation of a controlled temperature regime and the system of elements during its implementation are characterized by ease of use, reliability and ensuring the quality indicators of the technological process being performed. A further line of research is to substantiate the need to use the controlled cooling process to obtain the specified physical and mechanical parameters of the annealed wire.

articleTitle: Application of Pop-Up Learning Laboratories in Electrical Engineering Distance Education
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 4th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The base components of the concept of “Pop-Up Learning Lab” in engineering education including the purpose, learning methodologies, and the results of the concept implementation are presented in the article. It's proposed to consider the “Pop-Up Learning Lab” as a unique educational environment for the development of scientific and research competencies of future specialists. It's shown that the implementation of the concept provides the use of a project-based learning approach and it's available in the condition of distance education. Examples of practical implementation of the concept of “Pop-Up Learning Lab” in electrical engineering education are given. The possibility of teaching international and multilingual students remotely in the creation of their own Pop-Up Labs, and the joining efforts of several universities, including universities abroad, is shown.

articleTitle: Mathematical Model of Rheological Processes of Composite Materials Deformation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 4th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: Inelastic materials, in particular, composites are widely used in industry. This necessitates the development and research of mathematical models to describe the rheological properties of such materials at different temperatures and types of loads. The principle of heredity for the study of composite materials leads to the construction of the most general equations that take into account hereditary effects, the influence of speed, types of loading, operating conditions, etc. such prominent relations are integral equations of the Voltaire type. According to the law of inheritance and the principle of superposition, the total deformation of a body consists of the instantaneous deformation, which is determined by the stress acting at a given moment in time and related to it by Hooke's law, and the inherited deformation. The heredity principle is the most general principle that can be the basis of studies of the rheological properties of inelastic materials. The article formulates and describes a mathematical model based on this principle, which describes the behavior of composite materials in different loads and temperatures modes. The purpose of the article is to develop an adequate model of the environment, quite simple and convenient for describing the rheological properties of composites under conditions of various loads and elevated temperatures. Objectives of the article: to present the developed model for describing the rheological properties of composite anisotropic materials; show the method of determining viscosity and temperature parameters for inelastic materials; to demonstrate the possibility of predicting the behavior of composites in different modes of loads and temperatures. The mathematical model is an integral equation with a creep nucleus. The nucleus of the model is chosen in the form of the Abel nucleus. The parameters of the Abel nucleus are determined by experiments on samples of anisotropic composites. The loading mode can be any, for example, stretching the sample at different load speeds, or stress relaxation at constant deformations. As determined, temperature heredity is not significant. The behavior of the material is determined only by the value of temperature at a given time. The temperature effect function can be selected as a normal degree dependence. The model is determined by three parameters. The parameter determination problem can be solved analytically, for simple load cases. More complex load cases, require the use of computer technology and methods of approximate calculations. The advantage of the proposed model is the possibility to transfer certain parameters from one load mode to another. The basic relations are given; the method of determining the parameters of the hereditary model is described; theoretical and experimental research is presented; the possibility of predicting the behavior of composite materials at different temperatures is shown.

articleTitle: Modern Systems Engineering Education in the Context of the Formation of Professional Competences
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 4th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: Given the challenges that companies face in the 21st century, we should not forget about the training of relevant personnel, especially engineers. Ukrainian universities that train technical specialists, together with entrepreneurs, should develop an education system that will provide the appropriate desired qualification structure in the labor market. The article presents the results of a study conducted on the basis of a survey of groups of employers, students of technical universities and young engineers on their perception of the current education system in terms of the professional formation competencies of a progressive technical specialist. Based on the results of the socio-prognostic questionnaire “Choice of professional competences of an engineering and technical specialist”, it was noted that the integral components of an engineering and technical specialist are personal competence (the ability to assess weaknesses and strengths, self-development, self-improvement, etc.), as well as social competence - sociability, ability to work in a team, etc. All these competences are a requirement for the development of professional competence of an engineering and technical specialist, which is a flexible and dynamic phenomenon due to the constant innovative development of the technical environment. Therefore, the organization of the educational process in a higher educational institution plays a major role in the preparation of a future specialist in engineering and technical specialties.

articleTitle: Method for Evaluation the Pattern of Internet Service Customers Based on Stylometric Analysis Oof their Text Content
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 4th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: Messengers and chats of Internet services (in particular, transport companies, taxi services, energy generating companies etc.) are traditional tools for customer communication with the service provider and a means of feedback. Text messages from customers are a source of operational data and can contain important information about customer preferences, and opinions about certain service elements and quality. Tools of semantic and sentiment analysis allow us to give answers to these questions. However, the authors show the stylometric analysis of chat messages gives a lot of additional information about the personality of the customer himself, who often remains anonymous. The article proposes a method of segmentation of Internet service customers in the space of their stylometric characteristics. The authors also showed that in the space of stylometric characteristics there are certain homogeneous groups that have stable both stylometric patterns. These results can be the basis for the development of a classifier that will allow classifying a new customer by the nature of writing and optimizing his service. The use of such a method by managers or chatbots, in particular, based on artificial intelligence, will increase the level of service of the customers of service of power generating companies, etc.

articleTitle: Recognition of Prior Non-Formal and Informal Learning in Higher Education of Ukraine: Ways of Development
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 4th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: It has been substantiated that the attention to certain aspects of recognition of prior learning (RPL) in higher education is not the key to its success, it is necessary to ensure strategic planning and implementation of this process in accordance with the concept of life-long learning. The lack of Ukrainian practice is that the non-formal and informal education is not quite clear regulated in Ukraine in general and is not regulated in the Law of Ukraine “On the Higher Education”. It is grounded that it is important that access policies, admission processes and criteria in RPL are implemented consistently and in a transparent manner. It has been proved that the stakeholder involvement, especially in technical education, is very important for effective RPL mechanism and the needs of a wide range of stakeholders must be taken into account: external (potential employers in the region) and internal (students of a specific specialty). The main key points that will help improve RPL process in HEIs of Ukraine taking into account European and international best practice have been elaborated.

articleTitle: Qualimetric Approach for New Valeological Disciplines Assessing in Ukrainian Electrical and Power Engineering Education
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 4th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: Modern education is characterized by the transition from the content-knowledge-subject paradigm to the personal-activity (competence-based) paradigm. One of the components of the competency-based approach is to determine the effectiveness of students' education based on the level assessment of their educational achievements. Qualimetric models are one of the tools for assessing the success of competency formation. Single universities of Ukraine, which train specialists in engineering specialties (power engineers, electrical engineers and electromechanics), have introduced valeological disciplines into their educational programs to meet the requirements of National educational standards. Since 2019, the valeological discipline “Health Pedagogy” has been taught at the Ukrainian Engineering Pedagogics Academy. Qualimetry techniques were used to form a model of its teaching. The article describes the ways of constructing and the significance of applying factor-criteria competence models with a qualimetric assessment of learning outcomes in electrical and power engineering education on the example of this discipline. The results of studies of two groups of Ukrainian scientists (Kharkiv and Ivano-Frankivsk) were compared, each of which has its own ideas about the ways in which students develop a healthy lifestyle. As a result of a comparative study, it was found that a model based on a factor-criteria standard is more suitable for the formation of valeological competence of students of engineering specialties in Ukraine. The use of qualimetry makes it possible to assess the success of students in matters of competence formation, to establish the minimum acceptable level of competence formation for electric power engineers, electrical engineers, electromechanics, engineers-pedagogues' students of educational levels “bachelor” and “master”. Possible approaches to the formation of curricula of valeological disciplines are shown.

articleTitle: Introduction of Energy Storage Facilities as an Element of Industry 4.0 of the Energy Sector of Ukraine
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 4th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The article investigates the theoretical, methodological, and analytical provisions for the effective implementation of energy storage systems in the energy sector of Ukraine as one of the elements of Industry 4.0. Synthesis of research results allows us to identify key characteristics that contain the main approaches and recommendations for the implementation of energy storage systems in the energy sector of Ukraine based on foreign experience. In addition, the authors draw attention to the fact that the main objectives of energy storage systems as an element of the development of Industry 4.0 in the energy sector of Ukraine are the simplification of technological schemes; overall reduction in the cost of electricity supply through the use of DC systems; reduction of technological costs; increase the reliability of the integrated power system facilities; unloading of the general power supply network; ensuring constant and uninterrupted use of electricity; the possibility of local monitoring of energy efficiency; decentralization and decarbonization of Ukraine's energy sector.

articleTitle: Peculiarities of Blended Learning Laboratory Workshop for Electrical Engineering Students
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 4th International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy System (MEES)
abstract: The paper is devoted to the search for effective approaches to the educational process organization of electrical engineering students in emergency situations, in conditions of epidemiological, ecological, and man-made threats, during martial law.
